# anthropic_service_accounts (Data Source)

Lists service accounts in the organization. Requires `oauth_token`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_service_accounts" "all" {
  include_archived = false
}

output "service_account_names" {
  value = data.anthropic_service_accounts.all.service_accounts[*].name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `include_archived` (Boolean) Include archived service accounts. Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `service_accounts` (Attributes List) Service accounts. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--service_accounts))

<a id="nestedatt--service_accounts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `service_accounts`

Read-Only:

- `archived_at` (String) Archive timestamp; null while live.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `description` (String) Description; null when empty.
- `id` (String) Service account id.
- `name` (String) Slug name.
- `organization_role` (String) Organization role (`developer` or `admin`).
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
